body: The file has a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (lines 236–304). I'll convert `session.rs` into a directory module with `mod.rs` (impl, ≤300 lines) and `tests.rs` (tests), keeping `SessionCache` public at `crate::session::SessionCache`.

Done. Converted `cli/src/session.rs` (304 lines) into a directory module:

- `cli/src/session/mod.rs` — 237 lines, unchanged implementation; `pub struct SessionCache` remains at `crate::session::SessionCache`, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`.
- `cli/src/session/tests.rs` — 66 lines, tests moved verbatim with `use super::*`.
- Deleted old `session.rs` (no E0761).

Both files ≤300 lines. No docs/signatures/behaviour changed. `cargo check -p open-mtr-cli` passes. No tests/clippy run, no commit.
